lockup.summary: Directors, officers and holders of 5% or more have agreed not to sell for six months after the offering closes, with some exceptions. The company has agreed to the same six-month limit on issuing shares.

what: It is a Hong Kong online marketing firm that links brands with social media influencers and runs online ad campaigns.
proceeds: It plans to use about 40% to grow its business and customer base, 30% to buy more online media resources, and 30% for working capital and general costs.
risks: Clients may stop buying or spend less, and most client contracts are short-term and can end at any time without notice.
Losing ties with media channel partners and influencer agencies could cost the company advertising channels, clients and revenue.
It relies on influencer agencies and their influencers to deliver ads, and it has no direct control over the influencers.
It relies on media channel partners and their platforms to deliver ads and to give accurate advertising performance data.
It partly depends on contractors for the work of its Hong Kong operating subsidiary.
risks_note: The first 5 risk factors, summarised by AI.
